summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for the Multi-Format AI Banner Ad Studio featuring dual-mode generation (interactive editable canvas layers and studio AI renders), support for all standard Google Display, Social, and Marketplace banner formats, multi-aspect ratio and resolution (1K, 2K, 4K) controls using gemini-3-pro-image-preview and gemini-nano-banana-2.1, and automated product copy extraction via gemini-3.8-flash.
